entries.desc: Call quorum_submit with rounds=1 then again with rounds=3 at the same materialDigest -> refusal mentions the single overlapping runId (r1) even though r2/r3 are new; WHY: guard checks per-runId, not per-call, so partial overlap still triggers refusal for the colliding subset
listVerdicts returns zero verdicts for a brand-new storyId -> guard passes through without error; WHY: empty-verdict edge case should not accidentally block

Simulate a corrupted verdict file (non-JSON) in the local verdict directory for the story, then call quorum_submit -> guard either ignores the corrupt entry or throws a clear parse error, never silently skips the guard; WHY: dirty state should not let duplicates through
Call quorum_submit in rapid succession (two calls without material change) -> second call refused even under tight timing; WHY: no TOCTOU window where both calls pass the guard
Trigger duplicate-runId refusal -> error message contains each colliding runId string and the word "duplicate"; WHY: operator must see which runId(s) collided to diagnose the double-submit

evidence.note: Refusal message names the colliding runId(s): 'verdicts already exist for runId(s) ...-q-r1, ...-q-r2, ...-q-r3 at the current material' and states re-submitting would duplicate the quorum.

entries.desc: Trigger duplicate-runId refusal -> count host_verdict process events and verdict files before and after; counts are identical; WHY: proves no verdicts or side-effects are written on refusal

evidence.note: Smoke asserts hostVerdictEventCount and verdictFileCount are unchanged across the refused same-material re-submit, proving the guard short-circuits before any emit.

entries.desc: Trigger refusal when multiple runIds collide (e.g. rounds=3 re-submitted) -> message lists all 3 colliding runIds, not just the first; WHY: partial reporting would hide the scope of duplication

After a refusal (no verdicts written), call listVerdicts and summarizeVerdicts -> results are unchanged from pre-refusal baseline; WHY: ensures the guard truly short-circuits before any emit, not just swallows errors after partial writes

evidence.note: Smoke `refuses a same-material re-submit` asserts verdictFileCount + hostVerdictEventCount unchanged after the refusal (guard short-circuits before any emit). 11/11 pass, exit 0.

entries.desc: Submit quorum at materialDigest-A, then commit a material change (new file content), re-record reviewer passes, and submit quorum again -> second call succeeds with emittedCount = rounds*2; WHY: proves the guard keys on (runId, materialDigest) and does not false-block after material change

evidence.note: Smoke check 'allows a fresh quorum after a material change' commits a material change, re-records passes, re-submits, and asserts emittedCount=6 with 6 new verdict files — guard keys on (runId, materialDigest), not just runId.

entries.desc: Submit quorum, change material, re-quorum, then change material AGAIN and re-quorum a third time -> third call also succeeds; WHY: the guard must allow unbounded re-quorum cycles as long as each has a distinct materialDigest

Submit quorum at materialDigest-A, change material to materialDigest-B, re-quorum succeeds, then revert material back to materialDigest-A and attempt re-quorum -> refusal because materialDigest-A runIds already have verdicts; WHY: material revert is semantically a duplicate, guard must catch it

Submit quorum, then change ONLY non-material files (e.g. .lattice metadata only, no src changes) and re-submit -> if materialDigest is unchanged the guard still refuses; WHY: ensures the guard is truly keyed on materialDigest not on git HEAD or storyFilesHash alone

evidence.note: Guard predicate is `plannedRunIds.has(verdict.runId) && verdict.materialDigest === materialDigest` — keyed strictly on materialDigest, not git HEAD or storyFilesHash. A non-material change that leaves materialDigest unchanged therefore still refuses (same as the no-change same-material-refuses smoke case).
